name: MultiPlaneNeRF
definition: A NeRF model that uses non-trainable representations of 3D objects by projecting 3D points onto 2D images. It solves the problems of long training times and poor generalization to unseen data found in vanilla NeRF.
summary: MultiPlaneNeRF is a radiance field representation that uses a fixed set of pre-existing 2D images as a non-trainable 3D representation, enabling fast training and generalization without learnable voxel grids.
